SQLite amalgamation
===================

Upstream: https://sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip
Version: 3.54.1
SHA3-256 of the archive: 92281c86e2957f9b9305890f9ac04204caa7b677cc868dc326d942689df28e30
License: public domain (https://sqlite.org/copyright.html).

Copied files, unchanged: sqlite3.c, sqlite3.h.

Built as the kiln_sqlite library with the compile options androidx's sqlite-bundled uses
(sqlite/sqlite-bundled/build.gradle, SQLITE_COMPILE_FLAGS); see CMakeLists.txt. The NDK does
not export the platform's libsqlite, so apps carry this copy.

To update: replace the two files from a newer amalgamation and update this file.
